name: scenearcade
description: Publish a finished browser game to SceneArcade: pack it, play-test it, upload it and follow its review.

interface.shortDescription: Publish your browser game to SceneArcade
interface.longDescription: Publish a finished browser game to SceneArcade from your own computer. The assistant packs the game with its required cover, play-tests it, writes the testing report, uploads the ZIP to private storage with one command and follows the review status. Sign in once in your browser; you approve each upload.
defaultPrompt: Check the status of my SceneArcade submission.
